projects.title: Shortest Flight Path
description: Built a RESTful API in Spring Boot that enables users to construct flight paths between global airports within an Agile team of five.
Implemented a Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) algorithm with 2-opt iterative refinement, allowing users to progressively optimize route efficiency on repeated requests.
Gathered and analyzed stakeholder requirements, translating them into actionable development tasks.
Served as Scrum Master for one sprint cycle, facilitating Agile practices including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

projects.title: Employee Management
description: In an Agile team of 6, built a full-stack employee management application with a React frontend and Java backend, using Maven for the backend build/dependency managment and Node.js/npm (via NVM) for frontend tooling.
Applied Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices using Input Space Partitioning (ISP) and Base Choice Coverage (BCC) techinques to design test cases.
Utilized Randoop and EvoSuite for automated test generation, and SpotBugs for static code analysis, as part of a team focus on strengthening testing tools and practices

projects.title: Angular Real Estate
description: Built a real estate listing application individually to learn Angular, following Angular's official "First App" tutorial.
Implemented Angular Components and routing to display home listing pages and individual property detail views.

projects.title: MiniJava to MIPS Compiler
description: Built a 4-stage compiler, translating MiniJava source code into MIPS assembly
Implemented a lexical analyzer/scanner to tokenize MiniJava source code.
Performed semantic analysis and type checking to validate program correctness.
Generated MIPS assembly code from the validated AST.
